output.reason: The cited sentence is only a heading, but its own section says what it refers to. Four policy-level settings are deprecated: spec.validationFailureAction, spec.validationFailureActionOverrides, spec.mutateExistingOnPolicyUpdate and spec.generateExisting [ev-131accbf2c98]. They are replaced by per-rule fields: validate.failureAction/failureActionOverrides, verifyImages[].failureAction, mutate.mutateExisting and generate.generateExisting [ev-bc2d5eccce0f]. The rendered CRD diffs confirm those per-rule fields were added to the Policy and ClusterPolicy CRDs (v1 and v2beta1) [ev-236984661abb][ev-272f02d3e90d][ev-d4e55a3c3ecb][ev-4c73e901708e][ev-af63781cf017]. The consequence is stated directly: the deprecated fields will be removed in a future release and migration is recommended, so policies that still set the old fields keep working for now [ev-963b8a5003cf]. Confidence is low for two reasons: the heading also covers a separate change (PolicyException and CleanupPolicy graduating to v2, [ev-cfc86d03a623]), and the notes name mutate.mutateExisting while the CRD diff adds mutate.mutateExistingOnPolicyUpdate.
